text:
Type: striped rectangular lumbar cushion
Use: back support on a sofa, an armchair or a bed; living room, bedroom
Style: contemporary, coastal, bohemian
Materials: woven cotton fabric with yarn-dyed stripes
Colors: grey-green, taupe brown, black, sand beige, white
Shape: long rectangular cushion with vertical stripes of varying widths, fine pinstripe bands, plain edges, soft and plump
Feel: relaxed, earthy, casual, layered
Goes with: grey or beige sofas, warm wood, leather, olive green accents; contemporary, coastal or bohemian rooms
